nom: Charlotte Tilbury Dark Spot Correcting Radiance Recovery Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the lightweight, non-greasy formula did not add shine and still helped fade their dark spots.
segments.dry: The reviewer who identifies as having dry skin found the serum very hydrating, giving her face a noticeable glow even before seeing changes in her dark spots.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report no irritation, breakouts or rashes despite the serum's fragrance, though a couple felt mild burning on first application and others flag the scent itself as a concern for fragrance-sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers who mention dryness or hydration say the serum leaves skin feeling moisturized and glowing, including the reviewer with dry skin who calls it very hydrating despite it being marketed as a brightening treatment.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers with existing redness or post-blemish redness report it evening out and calming their skin, but this contrasts with one reviewer who developed persistent facial redness after a few days of use and stopped applying it to her face, attributing the reaction to its fragrance.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers used it specifically for dark spots, melasma, sun spots or post-acne marks and report gradual fading over two to several weeks of consistent use, describing it as slow but real; a number of short-term reviewers who tested it for only two to three weeks, however, report no visible change yet and say it needs more time to judge.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers say it helped minimize the darkness left after a breakout, but two reviewers report new pimples or an unusual breakout appearing after they started using it, one of whom said this was unusual for skin that otherwise never reacts to products.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say the lightweight, non-greasy formula does not make their skin look or feel oilier.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup without pilling
Visible results take several weeks of use
Pricey for the amount of product
Sparing use makes the bottle last

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's honestly hard to review a product like this, in just a couple of weeks. I feel that in order to get the full effect it could take a couple of months of persistent use. However, I used it and gave it a try anyhow. This is supposed to lighten the dark spots on your skin. I unfortunately didn't see any change in my skin. I have some spots that have developed on my face over the years and I didn't see a change in them. For the brand, I expected it to be more effective and to smell better. The smell was not pleasant. I can't quite put a finger on it but it smelled a lot like a cheap baby wipe. I had overall higher expectations for a product by this line and for the retail price that it goes for.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got to try this #complimentary product in exchange for my awfully honest review. I want to say that I don't have sensitive skin. No matter what I've thrown at it, my facial skin just doesn't negatively react. But, this, oddly, caused my face to "break out." It wasn't horrible or something I'd consider a problem with the product. My face just decided to be weird. The packaging is appealing and the scent & texture of the product are pleasant I continued to test this on the back of my hands. I have never been easy on my hands. From working on my car to dishes and raising three boys, my hands have been through a lot. I have age spots and thought thse were the perfect way to test this Dark Spot Corrector from Charlotte Tilbury Skin Care. I'm impressed that it actually did lighten my age spots! Without any extra precautions and just doing what I do daily, there is a noticeable difference. I definitely recommend giving this a try!

I began using this product 28 days ago. I began using on my face and the back of my hands. It smells amazing! It is such a light, delicate formula. A small pump covered my whole face easily. Another used on back of hands. Instant softness on both! After 3 days of use, I did discontinue use on my face as it seemed to cause redness that wasn't going away. Once I stopped using, 2 days later, the redness was gone. I believe it was whatever fragrance was in it because other ingredients haven't bothered me in other products. However, it didn't bother my hands at all so I continued use. After 28 days, I personally see a difference in the texture and the darkness of sun spots on my hands. They seem smoother and I don't think the spots are as dark and prominent. Excited to see progress with continued use!

extraits.texte: The Charlotte Tilbury Dark Spot Correcting Radiance Recovery Serum is very hydrating for my dry skin and gives my face a nice glow. I haven't personally noticed any difference in my dark spots yet, but my skin definitely feels smoother and looks brighter. There is a lovely scent, which I enjoy, but some people may consider to be problematic if they are sensitive to fragrances. It's on the pricey side for a serum, but I do think it works well for hydration and I like using it as part of my skincare routine. *I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very happy to have been able to try this product out, as I had been worrying about my under eye circles these past few weeks. This serum definitely took care of that issue and made me confident enough to skip concealer during my makeup routine. The only downside I have for this serum is that it did burn a bit when applying the first few times (I have sensitive skin). Fortunately, it didn't create any rashes, and was able to perform effectively.

The new dark spot recovery serum from Charlotte Tilbury is amazing! The formula is light and creamy and is not heavy or oily in any way. I have oily skin and did not feel like this made my skin oily! I tend to get dark spots and I truly felt like this serum helped to lessen them. I have been using this serum for about over 3 weeks and can certainly see a difference! The only note I have is there is a slight strong scent to this. If you are sensitive to scents, I am not sure if this is for you because I can sometimes still smell it even after application. It does not bother me though. The scent is pleasant. I have been applying this on my skin every morning before my moisturizer. I love the packaging as well, very sleek and clean. Charlotte Tilbury skincare never disappoints! Highly recommend this if you are in the market for a dark spot serum! I received this product for free for testing purposes.

extraits.titre: Perfect for my dark circles and dark spots
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This serum is so perfect for an even toned skin, I am loving it. I have hyperpigmentation spots , dark spots on my skin and noticeable dark circles around my eyes. I also have redness in my cheeks. I have noticed that after using this serum my hyperpigmentation spots , dark spots and dark circles are less noticeable and looks smoother and much more even toned. The redness in my cheeks are reduced too. I also loved how my skin got brighter and got a radiant glow after using this serum. I am impressed how lightweight is this serum, how it is not sticky at all and how well it absorbs into my skin.
